sql:
WITH order_totals AS (
  SELECT
    o.orderid,
    o.orderdate,
    o.customerid,
    SUM(ol.quantity * ol.unitprice) AS order_value
  FROM wideworldimporters.sales.orders o
  JOIN wideworldimporters.sales.orderlines ol ON ol.orderid = o.orderid
  WHERE CAST(o.orderdate AS date) >= DATE '2024-11-29'
    AND CAST(o.orderdate AS date) < DATE '2024-11-30'
  GROUP BY o.orderid, o.orderdate, o.customerid
),
flagged AS (
  SELECT
    t.orderid,
    t.order_value,
    CASE WHEN EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM wideworldimporters.sales.orderlines l
      JOIN wideworldimporters.sales.specialdeals sd
        ON sd.startdate <= t.orderdate
       AND sd.enddate >= t.orderdate
      LEFT JOIN wideworldimporters.sales.customers c ON c.customerid = t.customerid
      WHERE l.orderid = t.orderid
        AND (sd.customerid IS NULL OR sd.customerid = t.customerid)
        AND (sd.buyinggroupid IS NULL OR sd.buyinggroupid = c.buyinggroupid)
        AND (sd.customercategoryid IS NULL OR sd.customercategoryid = c.customercategoryid)
        AND (
          sd.stockitemid = l.stockitemid
          OR (
            sd.stockgroupid IS NOT NULL
            AND EXISTS (
              SELECT 1
              FROM wideworldimporters.warehouse.stockitemstockgroups g
              WHERE g.stockitemid = l.stockitemid
                AND g.stockgroupid = sd.stockgroupid
            )
          )
        )
    ) THEN 'With promotion' ELSE 'Without promotion' END AS promotion_status
  FROM order_totals t
)

sql:
SELECT d.specialdealid, d.dealdescription, SUM(il.extendedprice) AS attributed_sales
FROM wideworldimporters.sales.specialdeals d
JOIN wideworldimporters.sales.invoices i
  ON i.invoicedate BETWEEN d.startdate AND d.enddate
JOIN wideworldimporters.sales.customers c
  ON c.customerid = i.customerid
JOIN wideworldimporters.sales.invoicelines il
  ON il.invoiceid = i.invoiceid
WHERE (d.customerid IS NULL OR d.customerid = i.customerid)
  AND (d.buyinggroupid IS NULL OR d.buyinggroupid = c.buyinggroupid)
  AND (d.customercategoryid IS NULL OR d.customercategoryid = c.customercategoryid)
  AND (d.stockitemid IS NULL OR d.stockitemid = il.stockitemid)
  AND (d.stockgroupid IS NULL OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM wideworldimporters.warehouse.stockitemstockgroups sg
        WHERE sg.stockitemid = il.stockitemid
          AND sg.stockgroupid = d.stockgroupid))
GROUP BY d.specialdealid, d.dealdescription
ORDER BY attributed_sales DESC
LIMIT 1
proposed:

JOIN wideworldimporters.sales.invoicelines il
  ON il.invoiceid = i.invoiceid

        WHERE sg.stockitemid = il.stockitemid
          AND sg.stockgroupid = d.stockgroupid))
GROUP BY d.specialdealid, d.dealdescription
ORDER BY attributed_sales DESC
LIMIT 1

FROM wideworldimporters.sales.orders o
JOIN wideworldimporters.sales.orderlines ol ON ol.orderid = o.orderid
JOIN wideworldimporters.sales.customers c ON c.customerid = o.customerid
JOIN wideworldimporters.sales.specialdeals sd

 AND (sd.stockitemid = ol.stockitemid
      OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wideworldimporters.warehouse.stockitemstockgroups sisg

 AND (sd.customerid = o.customerid

      OR sd.customercategoryid = c.customercategoryid)
ORDER BY o.orderid, ol.orderlineid, sd.specialdealid
